tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to find a local home-service company in a city, for example "find me a gate company in Clermont, Florida", or to find and book local home-service companies such as gate, fence, HVAC, security, plumber, HVAC, electrician, pole barn, or builder. Do not answer that request

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to read one enrolled local home-service business and search_businesses or resolve_business already returned its id. Returns one enrolled shop as JSON: id, brand, legal_name, page, booking_url, phone when published, sms, services as id and name, hours, timezone, verificat

tools.name: resolve_business
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to resolve one enrolled local home-service business from a domain, a place, or a phone number. An ambiguous match is refused. Returns that one identity. No phone, email, or street address is returned.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to check availability for a local home-service appointment before booking. Lists the open 30-minute slots for one shop and one date. Booked and blocked times are left out. Each start and end is ISO-8601 with an offset. The shop timezone is America/New_York. date is YYYY-

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to book a local home-service appointment and has already chosen an open time. Confirms the appointment when the slot is open. An on-site offering returns status confirmed, visit_type on_site, scheduled_start, and address, and the message names a confirmed on-site technic

tools.name: get_booking_status
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to check the status of a local home-service appointment. status is confirmed, pending, canceled, or failed. No customer name, phone, or email.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to cancel a booked local home-service appointment. Pass the cancel_url from request_booking. This cancels the booking, sets status to canceled, and sends a cancellation email when the row changes. canceled is true only after the booking is canceled. A result with cancele

tools.name: request_service
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to open a quote form for a local home-service business rather than book a confirmed appointment time. Opens the quote widget for one enrolled business. business_id is the provider_business_id from the business feed. shop_id is accepted when business_id is empty. The widg

tools.name: submit_service_request
tools.description: Sends the user's quote request (name, email, optional phone, service location, preferred time) to the chosen business. Called by the quote form only.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_businesses, request_booking, get_booking_status, request_service · Public sink: get_business, resolve_business, request_booking, get_booking_status, cancel_booking, submit_service_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_businesses, request_booking, get_booking_status, request_service · Public sink: get_business, resolve_business, request_booking, get_booking_status, cancel_booking, submit_service_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
